lines: New Year's, the Fuuma residence.
Fuuma Amane
「――I heard, Young Lord, that last year was terrible, with you getting a serious injury, and whatnot.」
Amane
「Might the cause of that be Tokiko's inadequacy as a steward?」
Amane
「As the Young Lord, do you not now desire another, more capable butler?」
Me
「Uhh, not particularly......?」
Fuuma Tokiko
「A-Amane?! What are you saying, right from the start of the year like this?!」
Amane
「Hmph. I'm saying it precisely because it's the new year. One's plans for the year should be made on New Year's Day.」
Amane
「After all, last year I suffered the humiliation of being away from the Young Lord's side because of a pointless mission.」
Amane
「That's not going to happen this year. No matter what happens, I will be at the Young Lord's side! Naturally, I will be of more use than the likes of Tokiko.」
Amane
「In the first place, Tokiko is the kind of pervert who would use her position as older sister to seduce and cozy up to the Young Lord. I would be far preferable to a dirty woman like――」
Tokiko
「Hey, hey, hey?! What are you suggesting, Amane?! You're drunk, aren't you?!」
Tokiko
「Stop making these weird false accusations while Lord-sama is listening!!」
Me
Amane
「Hmph, false accusations? What's wrong with anticipating the kind of misdeeds an inadequate steward would commit?!」
Tokiko
「T-Turning it back on me, are you?! If that's how you want it, then I've got some thoughts of my own!!」
Me
Neither of them were listening.
The two women, whose cheeks were red after multiple New Year's drinks, were engaging in a lighthearted argument in front of my eyes.
On this day, a New Year's party was being held at the Fuuma mansion, with relatives attending.
All the people who were normally away from Gosha came to show their faces for this one day only.
The woman in the butler outfit who was arguing with Tokiko―Fuuma Amane―was one of those.
Me
（Still, it sure is novel for Tokiko to get like that.）
Tokiko was always mature and composed.
Despite that, now, she was losing her cool with a more natural face, almost to the point where you could call her childish.
Me
（That's probably...... because the other person is Amane, isn't it?）
Amane was slightly older than Tokiko, and――she was her senpai as a butler, too, in a sense.
That was probably why Tokiko felt secure in showing emotion on her face, without needing to paper over it like when she interacted with me, or Hebiko, or others.
Indeed――
Fuuma Amane was Tokiko's senpai figure as a steward――the woman who used to serve as the butler of my father, Fuuma Danjou.
Like Tokiko and Saika, she was born into a prestigious Fuuma lineage.
Previously, she had served Fuuma Danjou, and, after his death, had fulfilled his dying wishes and been hostile to Gosha.
But at present, she had sworn allegiance to Gosha, to serve me, the current head of the family, as my steward.
Me
（Well...... a “self-appointed” one, though.）
Steward was the heighest position in a household, only one per family, and Tokiko was serving that role in the head Fuuma family right now.
However, it seemed that Amane, the steward who served in the previous generation, still had no intention of recognizing her yet.
Accordingly, she claimed to be my self-professed steward, and emphatically promoted herself as such to me and Tokiko.
However, it wouldn't be good for this conflict between the current and previous stewards to develop into an internal feud――

On the orders of Asagi-sensei, who had judged that, Amane was often given missions outside of Gosha, and had been transferred to a government agency for most of last year, only being able to return to the village at the
very end of it.
From what I heard, partially because of those circumstances, Amane was extremely motivated to 『be by the Young Lord's side this year for sure!』
Fuuma Aki
「Hmm～......? Tokiko and Amane-san are sure eccentric people.」
Aki
「That aside, young Kotarou was so cute I wanted to lick him up, but now he's just an old man, huh?」
Me
「U-Uh, Aki-nee......? I don't think I'm an old man yet......」
It had been a while since we last met, but she was the same person as ever.
The seemingly butch-looking woman who was gulping down booze next to me――She was also Fuuma kin.
Her name was Fuuma Aki.
In the past, she had lived near the old Fuuma mansion and often doted on me, but for some reason, as I grew up, her treatment had grown increasingly brusque, and had stayed that way to this day.
It was rumoured that normally, she was on an undercover mission somewhere on Asagi-sensei's orders, but......
She was a natural vagrant, and never tried to interact with the Fuuma clan voluntarily, so I had no idea what she was doing in the slightest.
That was what Aki-nee was like, but it seemed that, just for New Year's, she had still returned to Gosha and shown her face at this party.
Aki
「Well, enough about that―― Here, Kotarou, your New Year's money.」
Me
「What?! Are you sure, Aki-nee?!」
Aki-nee handed over a small pouch.
Aki
「Well... Honestly, I don't want to, and you're not little anymore either. But it's a relative's duty, so...」
Me
「Th-That's pretty blunt......」
Me
「But I'm happy, Aki-nee!! Thanks!!」
I was perpetually short on cash. I'd give a warm welcome to any New Year's gift I could get.
Fuuma Saika
「Oh, New Year's money? Well then, Young Lord-sama, here's some from me as well――」
Me
「Ohh?! Saika??!!」
The woman sitting next to Aki-nee―Saika―handed me her New Year's gift.
She was also a Fuuma relative.
She was a kindly mature woman who once used to serve my father, Danjou, as his secretary.
Me
「――Like, awesome!! What's with the thickness of this bag?!」
Aki
「Lemme see...... Huuuh?!」
Aki-nee and I opened our eyes wide, peering into Saika's New Year's gift bag.
Bulky. There was a bulge several times the size of the one in the New Year's gift pouch I had just received from Aki-nee.
Saika
「Fufu, the Young Lord-sama is at that age now, after all.」
Saika
「When you go on a date, for instance, you'll be looked down on if you don't have this much money on hand.」
Aki
「I see! Kotarou is old enough to take an interest in the opposite sex, huh? You got a girlfriend?」
Me
「I do not! I don't, but thanks a ton, Saika! I'll use it carefully!!」
Saika
「Oh, my pleasure♪ And, keep this a secret from Tokiko――」
Tokiko
「H-Hey, Saika―― h?! What are you doing?!」
Tokiko had clearly seen me receive the bulky pouch from Saika.
Tokiko
「Th-That's unacceptable!! You mustn't spoil Lord-sama like that!!」
Tokiko
「Lord-sama is to be the head of the family. He has to cultivate a strong sense of fiscal management while he's a student――」
Amane
「――Th-That's right!! Are you trying to steal all the glory, Saika?! That's unfair!! Well, here's your New Year's money from me too, Young Lord!!」
Me
「Your whole wallet?! Are you sure, Amane?!!」
Amane
「Is it not enough? If you like, I can add a card――」
Tokiko
「No, you CAAAAAANNNNN'T!!!」
Tokiko shouted. And then――
Sniffing out the scent of spending money, “she” popped out at my feet.
Sakura
「Ehhh～～?!! What, what?! New Year's money from everyone, but only for Fuuma-kun? No faaaaiiiiirrr!!」
Aki
「Whoa?! Something came out?!!」
Aki-nee opened her eyes wide at Sakura, who had jumped out from my shadow.
But, perhaps because she was already pretty plastered, she easily brushed it off with, 「Well, whatever! Ahaha!」
Sakura
「Fif-tyyy-fif-tyyy! Fuuma-kun, please gimme New Year's money too!」
Amane
「Young Lord! Even going by the amount of New Year's money, I still make a better steward than――」
Saika
「Fufu, Young Lord-sama♪ Would you like another helping of zouni?」
Aki
「Ahahahahahaha!!」
Tokiko
「H-Heyyy!!! What's with you all?!!」
Tokiko
「That's no fair, isn't it?!! The truth is, I wanted to spoil Lord-sama tooooo!!」
Me
「Huuuuuuh～～～～～??!! I mean, don't you guys all come at ooonnnnnce!!!」
She really must have been pretty drunk.
Making her face red with teary eyes, Tokiko rushed towards me, dragging Amane, Saika and Sakura along with her.
Me
「Mmguuh......」
I was crushed by the Fuuma women (+ Sakura).
Aki
「Ahahahahahahahaha!!」
Aki-nee, the only one who was safe, was laughing loudly.
Just at that moment, the living room door opened with a clatter.
Library
「Lord-sama. Your friends have come to see you.」
Me
I raised my face.
And when I did, two friends looked down at me, pressed closely against the Fuuma women (+ Sakura).
Uehara Shikanosuke
「Yo, Fuuma, we came to hang out――Wait, what? Oi?! What's with this enviable situation?!」
Aishuu Hebiko
「F-Fuuma-chaaaaan?! What are you doing, right from the start of the yeeeeeeeaaar～～～～～～～～～?!!!」
The New Year's party had continued even after the sun set.
Not only had the kin of the present head, Kotarou, visited, but so too had lots of friends that he had made last year, and the Fuuma residence was enveloped by lively laughter.
Among them――
Amane
「Fuuh...... I wonder if I went a little over the top.」
Fuuma Amane had gone out into the garden on her own to sober up.
It was probably also because she had been under stress, being transferred to a government agency for a year, which one could even call enemy territory.
It looked like, surrounded by familiar faces, her drinking had unintentionally gone too far.
Library
「You should drink this. It will take your mind off things for a while.」
Amane
「Ah, Sagou......... No, it's Library now, huh?」
She accepted the cup that had been held out.
She had heard briefly about the circumstances of Taimanin Library―Sagou Bungo―from the man himself.
Amane muttered ,「Thanks,」 took a mouthful of the sobering-up drink, and then sighed loudly.
Amane
「......Still, I can't believe it.」
Amane
「That you and I would wind up serving the same master again――」
Library
Taimanin Library, a.k.a. Sagou Bungo.
And Fuuma Amane.
The two of them were staunch comrades in rebellion, who had once been close aides of the former head of the Fuuma family, Danjou, who had raised the banner of revolt in Gosha.
And they had continued to fight after his insurrection had been crushed, right up until the end――even after Danjou had died.
Library
「......One never knows what will happen in the course of one's life. Even the smallest of things can change the way a person lives.」
Amane
「That's right, isn't it? If back then――」
She made a bitter smile, and closed her eyes.
Indeed, that was―――
Four years ago. In the Gosha mountains.
Ninja

「――Death to the traitor!!」
「After her! She won't get far!」
Amane
「Haah haah...... Kuku, don't make me laugh......」
Amane
「You're the traitors here......」
Amane ran, while hiding herself among the dense foliage.
Perhaps because she was seriously wounded, her movements were heavy and sluggish.
And pursuing her was a threatening group outfitted in ninja attire.
Ninja

「There she is! It's Danjou's steward!!」
「Don't let her get away!!」
Amane
「Kuh――」
In front of Amane, who breathed raggedly from her injuries, shinobi blocked the way, brimming with cold bloodthirst.
